verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own plan/apply split supports a basic review gate: `tofu plan` previews changes, speculative plans can be checked before code review, and `-out=FILE` saves a plan that `tofu apply` later executes exactly as written. Plan files can also be encrypted at rest. Nothing shows least-privilege credential scoping, enforced approval gates, or policy-as-code that would stop an agent from applying unapproved changes. missing for 10: least-privilege/scoped credential mechanism, enforced approval gate before apply, policy-as-code checks, agent-specific guardrails, independent corroboration.
